$comment: Mockup kit v2: the sourced record behind kit.css. One CSS px in a frame = one logical unit on the target. Every value carries basis + src; kit.css uses the custom property named in 'var'. Perishable: re-check before a final spec.

unit.wechat: 1 px at the 375 design width = 2 rpx

basis.digest: a numbered fact in research/sources/<id>.md; src = id#fact
basis.derived: computed from a sourced value; 'note' says how
basis.primary: read from a primary page on 2026-09-27 by the skills stream; not yet in a research digest
basis.field: lab field evidence (one host session); not a platform source
basis.example: a value its source calls an example, not a norm
basis.approx: drawing value with no public source (for iOS bars the HIG publishes none); replace with the platform UI kit's value before a spec

sources.web:iphone-17: https://support.apple.com/en-us/125089 ('2622-by-1206-pixel resolution at 460 ppi'; same on apple.com/iphone-17/specs/)
sources.web:iphone-air: https://support.apple.com/en-us/125092 ('2736-by-1260-pixel resolution at 460 ppi'; same on apple.com/iphone-air/specs/)
sources.kit-0.7.0: carried over from the 0.7.0 kit, which never cited a source

iphone-17.note: px / 3 (@3x); iPhone 17 and 17 Pro share it. HIG Layout no longer lists device sizes (apple-hig-liquid-glass#20).

iphone-17-pro-max.note: px / 3 (@3x); matches the 6.9-inch App Store screenshot size 1320x2868 px in apple-hig-liquid-glass (open items)

android-phone.note: a compact-width drawing size (compact < 600 dp); no device size is in a digest. Check 360 wide too.

android-fold-open.note: width = start of 'expanded' (840 dp); height is a drawing value

matepad.note: the digest's px-to-vp table gives one pair for tablets; read as vp

wechat-375.note: 375 = fixed layout that scales (390 = responsive, adapt per size); the 812 height is approx

windows-window.note: drawing size inside the 'large' window class (>= 1008 epx); state the minimum window size

browser.note: the lab's desktop capture viewport; add 390 wide for the phone check

office-pane.note: task pane width 320-480 px; draw 320 and 480 before a spec; height is approx

chat-inline.note: the spec's example containerDimensions {width: 400, maxHeight: 600}; no host publishes sizes (openai-apps-sdk-ui, open items)

tab-bar.v: floats over content on glass; navigation only; search tab separate at the trailing end

tab-bar-height.note: not in the HIG (apple-hig-bars, open items)

tab-bar-shape.v: capsule (radius = height / 2) with margin from the screen edge

tab-minimized.v: current tab at the leading corner, accessory centre, search trailing; expands on tab tap or scroll to top

accessory-use.v: persistent features such as media playback, never a screen-specific action; the demo reads an inspection round in progress across tabs as persistent

selected-tab.v: accent on the selected symbol and label; the others monochrome; no indicator shape

badge.v: red oval, white number or '!', critical information only

system-blue.note: light / dark; white text on it is 3.5 / 3.2:1, below the text minimum in color.md, so a design that needs AA sets its own --mk-tint and --mk-on-tint

system-red.note: light / dark badge fill; white numerals on it are 3.6 / 3.4:1, so the demo sets --mk-badge to its own danger fill

toolbar-groups.v: <= 3 groups; one .prominent action, trailing, colour on its background

scroll-edge.v: a scroll edge effect instead of an opaque bar; one per view

ipad-tab-bar.v: near the top, fixed or convertible to a sidebar; five tabs or fewer

app-bar-small.note: title = title-large 22/28; fills with surface-container on scroll

nav-bar.note: flexible bar; baseline 80 dp is no longer recommended

nav-indicator.note: secondary-container; active label secondary; icon 24; label-medium 12/16 500

toolbar.note: docked replaces the bottom app bar; floating = fully rounded, elevation level3, 16 dp external padding; never with a nav bar

rail-collapsed.note: expanded rail 220-360 dp replaces the drawer

safe-top.note: phone screen-edge margin top 36 vp, read as the status inset

safe-bottom.note: phone screen-edge margin bottom 28 vp, read as the indicator inset

title-bar.note: large title bar 112; Free mode shrinks on scroll

title-blur-below.note: gradient blur below the bar, coloured like the page

tabs-floating-width.note: 3 and 2 tabs: window < 600 / >= 600 vp; tablets x1.15; the HdsTabs API default differs (digest open items)

tab-item.v: icon 24 vp; label 10 vp (Caption_M); inactive = lower opacity or grey (the kit uses font_secondary, 60 %); no indicator shape

brand.note: light / dark system brand colour; the design overrides it

materials.v: top floating ULTRA_THIN + gradient blur; bottom floating THIN + gradient colour; popovers THICK; sheets ULTRA_THICK

capsule.note: read wx.getMenuButtonBoundingClientRect() at runtime; host-placed on every page, only a light or dark scheme

capsule-rule.v: reserve its area; custom navigation must look different from it

tab-bar.note: native bottom tabs: home page only; 2-5 items, <= 4 advised; selected = icon + label colour

tab-rule.v: 2-5 tabs, <= 4 advised, native bottom style on the home page only

window-radius.note: 0 when snapped or maximised; in-page controls 4

title-bar-search.note: with a centred search box or a person picture

window-icon.v: 16x16, 16 from the edge; title in Caption style 16 after it

materials.v: Mica base (title bar blends in); content layer or cards on it; Acrylic only for transient surfaces; Smoke under dialogs

type.v: Caption 12/16, Body 14/20, Body Strong 14/20 semibold, Subtitle 20/28, Title 28/36

sidebar.v: inset glass floating over content; content extends beneath

title-bar-overlay.v: title bar and toolbar float over content, which runs beneath; traffic lights in the sidebar's top corner

pane-width.note: user-resizable; follows the host's theme; separate origin and storage; no Office design source in a digest yet

pane-header.note: drawn by the host, not by the add-in

tokens.v: Fluent 2 web: Body 1 14/20, Subtitle 2 16/22, Caption 1 12/16; corner 4

inline-card.v: <= 2 actions at the bottom (one primary); no nested scroll, tabs or drill-ins

fullscreen.v: host composer always overlaid; outer radius drops to 0

border.v: prefersBorder true = host draws border and background; set it explicitly

materials.$comment: data-material roles drawn by .mk-glass and friends. The CSS is a labelled approximation of layering and legibility risk, never the platform material: no platform publishes blur or tint numbers (apple-hig-liquid-glass, open items). The handoff names the role and the platform material.

glass-regular.harmonyos: 沉浸光感: top floating ULTRA_THIN + gradient blur; bottom floating THIN + gradient colour mask; popovers and menus THICK; half-modal sheets and dialogs ULTRA_THICK
glass-regular.windows: background (desktop) Acrylic for flyouts, context menus and light-dismiss panes; in-app Acrylic for panes over content (NavigationView compact/minimal)

glass-clear.ios: Liquid Glass clear, over media only, with a 35 % dimming layer when the content is bright

surface-raised.all: opaque fill with elevation (M3 tonal level, Windows stroke + shadow)
